parent_objective: audit M2375 repair-plan artifacts before any repair execution route
blocked_by: M2375 materializes repair-plan artifacts but does not execute or audit repair readiness
repair-plan artifacts require audit before implementation or validation design
supersedes: direct repair execution from repair-plan artifacts without audit
training or scenario redesign execution that ignores claim boundary

public_gates: M2376 must audit M2375 repair-plan summary, output family counts, and claim boundary without executing repair
M2376 must identify the next bounded route or stop the branch
M2376 must keep repair execution, ranking, winner selection, paper finite-window-vs-GRU, current-sim verdict, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, and level3 self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not inject hidden or oracle features
do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits repair-plan artifacts before any repair execution route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no repair execution, rerun, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if M2375 artifacts are incomplete or internally inconsistent
stop if guardrail constraints are missing
stop if audit would route directly to training without repair-plan implementation or validation design
stop if audit claims scenario redesign executed or training repair success
fallback_plan: route to repair-plan schema repair if artifacts are inconsistent
route to bounded next design if artifacts are accepted
route to branch synthesis if repair-plan artifacts are insufficient to choose a route

allowed_updates: M2376 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2375 artifacts are accepted or rejected
output family and guardrail counts are summarized
a bounded next route is selected or branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2376 audits repair-plan artifacts and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2376; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Repair-plan artifacts remain engineering design artifacts until repair execution and measured validation.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits repair-plan artifacts but does not yet test capability
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit bounded next design but cannot establish paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: M2376 cannot audit or route from repair-plan artifacts
M2376 proposes direct profile ranking or paper conclusion
the repair-plan materialization branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: Auditing M2375 repair-plan artifacts can decide the next bounded route without executing repair, ranking, training, or paper-level claims.
success_criteria: M2375 output family counts and guardrail exclusions are audited
repair execution, ranking, winner selection, paper-level, finite-window-vs-GRU, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, current-sim verdict, and level3 self-ID claims remain blocked
a bounded non-ranking follow-up route is selected or branch is stopped
failure_criteria: M2376 reruns reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2376 executes repair levers or trains
M2376 ranks support policies or controller families
M2376 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU current-sim verdict or level3 self-ID claims
M2376 claims scenario redesign executed or training repair success
M2376 cannot decide next route from complete repair-plan artifacts

commands.name: audit
commands.command: manual audit of M2375 repair-plan artifacts

decision_rule: M2376 passes if it audits M2375 repair-plan artifacts and selects a bounded non-ranking follow-up route or stops the branch.
